164	#### Infinitary meets and joins
165	
166	For a family `f : I → Con 𝑨 {L}` indexed by `I : Type ℓ₀`, the infinitary meet is the
167	intersection `⋀ f` (which holds at `(x , y)` iff every `f i` does), and the
168	infinitary join is the congruence generated by the union, `⋁ f = Cg(⋃ f)`.  Both stay
169	at level `L` because `I` is `ℓ₀`-small.  The meet is the greatest lower bound and the
170	join the least upper bound of the family.
171	
172	```agda
173	  module _ {I : Type ℓ₀} (f : I → Conᴸ) where
174	
175	    -- Infinitary meet: the intersection of the family.
176	    ⋀ : Conᴸ
177	    ⋀ = (λ x y → (i : I) → proj₁ (f i) x y) , mkcon m-refl m-equiv m-comp
178	      where
179	      open Setoid 𝔻[ 𝑨 ] using ( _≈_ )
180	      m-refl : ∀ {a₀ a₁} → a₀ ≈ a₁ → (i : I) → proj₁ (f i) a₀ a₁
181	      m-refl e i = reflexive (proj₂ (f i)) e
182	
183	      m-equiv : IsEquivalence (λ x y → (i : I) → proj₁ (f i) x y)
184	      m-equiv = record
185	        { refl   = λ i → IsEquivalence.refl (is-equivalence (proj₂ (f i)))
186	        ; sym    = λ p i → IsEquivalence.sym (is-equivalence (proj₂ (f i))) (p i)
187	        ; trans  = λ p q i → IsEquivalence.trans (is-equivalence (proj₂ (f i))) (p i) (q i)
188	        }
189	
190	      m-comp : 𝑨 ∣≈ (λ x y → (i : I) → proj₁ (f i) x y)
191	      m-comp g h i = is-compatible (proj₂ (f i)) g (λ k → h k i)
192	
193	    -- Infinitary join: the congruence generated by the union of the family.
194	    ⋁ : Conᴸ
195	    ⋁ = Cg (λ x y → Σ[ i ∈ I ] proj₁ (f i) x y)
196	
197	    ⋀-lower : (i : I) → ⋀ ⊆ f i
198	    ⋀-lower i p = p i
199	
200	    ⋀-greatest : (ψ : Conᴸ) → (∀ i → ψ ⊆ f i) → ψ ⊆ ⋀
201	    ⋀-greatest ψ ψ⊆f p i = ψ⊆f i p
202	
203	    ⋁-upper : (i : I) → f i ⊆ ⋁
204	    ⋁-upper i p = base (i , p)
205	
206	    ⋁-least : (ψ : Conᴸ) → (∀ i → f i ⊆ ψ) → ⋁ ⊆ ψ
207	    ⋁-least ψ f⊆ψ = Cg-least {𝑨 = 𝑨} ψ (λ (i , p) → f⊆ψ i p)
208	```
209	
210	#### The complete lattice
211	
212	Packaging the order with the infinitary operations and their universal properties
213	yields the complete lattice of congruences.
214	
215	```agda
216	  Con-CompleteLattice : CompleteLattice (α ⊔ ρ ⊔ ov {𝑆 = 𝑆} L) (α ⊔ L) (α ⊔ L) ℓ₀
217	  Con-CompleteLattice = record
218	    { Carrier          = Conᴸ
219	    ; _≈_              = _≑_
220	    ; _≤_              = _⊆_
221	    ; isPartialOrder   = ⊆-isPartialOrder
222	    ; ⨆                = ⋁
223	    ; ⨅                = ⋀
224	    ; ⨆-upper          = λ f i → ⋁-upper f i
225	    ; ⨆-least          = λ f x h → ⋁-least f x h
226	    ; ⨅-lower          = λ f i → ⋀-lower f i
227	    ; ⨅-greatest       = λ f x h → ⋀-greatest f x h
228	    }
229	```
